propositions: Commit 40b8ac8295 activates runtime.py on every bridge pass, but runtime.py:39 has unconditional module-scope `from pydantic import SecretStr` while the bridge installs core without [agents] extra, causing ModuleNotFoundError on three consecutive scheduled passes.

The reconciler engine/bridge is contracted to remain stdlib-only per pyproject.toml and docs/config.md, but optional pydantic dependency was imported at module scope instead of lazily at authentication boundaries.
Clean no-extras installs fail with ModuleNotFoundError at runtime.py:39; installing pydantic clears it; historical A/B testing shows success before runtime eager-load and failure after.
StaticAuth credential representation and equality must exclude the secret while reveal() returns the exact token at authentication boundaries, without introducing new Pydantic dependency.
The fix replaces pydantic.SecretStr with frozen stdlib string field; scheduled bridge run 32155185851 on merged SHA passes and CloudWatch alarm rebar-bridge-run-failures transitions to OK.
Reconciler module-scope optional import sweep found no siblings; Jira imports are lazy at adapter boundaries and not affected.
